StorageDirectoryMapping.description: Mapping of backing Cloud Storage path to the directory where the user lands in the SFTP server. If directory is not specified, it'll default to '/'. Eg 1 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: /abc/def/username) The user will land at /abcd/def/username, and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2. The user will not be aware of Cloud Storage prefix '/bucket/path1' and there will be no such directory in the view. Eg 2 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: '') The user will land at '/', and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2.
